entries.prompt:
Generate VERSION A: isolate faithfully the existing rigid biomask of the PREDATOR from the announced NECA DC/Dark Horse BATMAN vs PREDATOR SDCC2019 2-pack, exactly as photographed in the FIRST official publisher preview. The source mask is the LARGE dark silver helmet near x354..651,y9..447 in the1300x867 scene photograph. Preserve the real downward-bowed nearly frontal/three-quarter SOURCE camera, roll and foreshortening; do not make a new straight-on inventory view. SECOND official white-background catalogue photo confirms the same edition's silver-grey paint and yellow/yellow-green optic lenses; the bare anatomical head in its inset and armored Batman are NOT mask references. This is the announced2019 licensed physical source edition, not certification of final retail or comic-panel geometry.
Preserve the complete visible rigid outline: shallow rounded dark-silver oval crown/forehead field, actual broad curved raised perimeter whose two small rear ends rise around the real upper central opening/notch, the low angled brow boundaries, narrow YELLOW optic lens shapes, short broad rounded rectangular center nose/muzzle plate, real silver cheek wings and source-attested small side ridges/fittings. The opening/gap at the upper rear rim exposes the red wearer in the photo; exclude that red skin and leave the source-observed gap open, without inventing more openings. The long oval forehead is smooth with only its actual curved border, NO central glyph. Retain only visible large and fine details truly supported by this large photo. Do not substitute film Jungle Hunter, City Hunter, Scar or another generic mask; no extra runes, ports, screws, spikes, scars or ornate detail.
Use the actual neutral dark grey/silver painted-metal albedo and yellow lenses; strong CYAN rimlight in the scene is illumination, NOT blue paint, so remove the colored scene cast under neutral soft studio light without changing the silver/yellow palette. Keep the existing source wear restrained and actual outline/angle unchanged. No new damage, colored panels, green physical metal or bronze paint.
Remove all dreadlocks, red flesh, organic anatomy/mandibles, neck, shoulder cannon (at the right beside/below the source mask), armor/body, necklace, weapons, scenery, text and logos. One complete visible rigid shell only, no invented hidden backside or straps, genuine alpha transparent PNG. Center the exact SOURCE-view object at about76–80%of larger canvas axis,8–12%clear margin each side including the crown tips; no clipping, opaque backdrop, floor/shadow plane/checkerboard/UI/caption/multiple views. One native finished transparent PNG. Provisional licensed physical source study, canonCertified=false.

entries.prompt:
Create VERSION B of this EXACT announced NECA DC/Dark Horse Batman vs Predator SDCC2019 rigid silver-grey biomask. FIRST reference is selected A and is the precise sculpture/projection/optic authority: keep the shallow oval forehead field, broad raised curved rim with real upper rear notch between two small ends, slight bowed nearly frontal/three-quarter source view, same roll, low brows, yellow optic shapes, broad short rectangular central muzzle, silver cheeks and existing small side fittings. Keep mask-only width/height ratio about0.703; do not lengthen/narrow/widen it, close the upper source notch, add a center glyph, new vents/holes/runes/screws/scars or reconstruct a backside. SECOND reference is the actual publisher scene photo18 of the physical preview, supporting identity/material only. No camera rotation, no generic film Jungle Hunter/City Hunter replacement.
Change ONLY material and light to cohesive PHG game-asset quality: neutral white upper-left key, soft neutral fill, controlled roughness of restrained worn dark grey/silver metal and subtle uniform micrograin, legible existing yellow/yellow-green optic material. Preserve A's source silver/yellow albedo. The source photo's strong CYAN edge light is scene illumination, not blue paint; no cyan/blue rimlight, coloured physical metal, bronze finish, white chrome, bloom or new weathering. All organic anatomy/scalp/dreads, neck/body, cannon, armor, necklace, weapons, scenery, caption/logos/UI remain absent. Do not put red flesh into the real upper rear opening; keep that source notch genuine alpha.
This is a provisional physical-source study of the named ANNOUNCED SDCC2019 publisher preview (pre-sale article May2019), not certification of final retail production or original comic-panel geometry. Retain this exact existing source sculpture and palette.
One complete isolated mask only, centered on genuine transparent alpha. Give full object at least10%empty transparent space above and below, longest dimension78–80%of canvas, not~91%as A. Improve only ImageGen canvas composition; never stretch/rotate object geometry. At least8–12%clear margin each side, no clipping. One native finished transparent PNG, no floor/shadow plane/opaque backdrop/checkerboard/text/multiple views/contact sheet.
